card.name: Liver injury warning phrases
card.fires_on: Commas and linking words (of, with) inside liver-warning text, such as hepatitis B reactivation leading to fulminant hepatitis, hepatic failure, or lists of liver injury symptoms.

modes.label: Comma in liver outcome lists
modes.description: Comma after a liver term, just before the next item in the list, such as hepatic failure.
modes.example: in some cases resulting in fulminant hepatitis<<,>> hepatic failure and death, can occur

modes.label: Comma in symptom lists
modes.description: Comma between symptoms of liver injury such as fatigue, anorexia, jaundice.
modes.example: right upper abdominal discomfort<<,>> dark urine or jaundice. Dos

modes.label: Linking word in liver monitoring
modes.description: Small words like of or with in liver test or monitoring statements.
modes.example: Hepatic function should be monitored closely<< with>> both clinical and laboratory follow-up for at

card.writes: No clear meaning; the promoted tokens are unrelated Chinese characters and the suppressed ones are Palestine-related names.
card.plain: It fires on commas and small joining words in liver-damage warnings, such as hepatitis B flare and liver failure lists.
